question: Who is fit to receive this Kaula tradition according to the teaching?
premises: This is identified as the Kaula tradition.
It is associated with those free from elaboration.
The bound being is contrasted in this context.
inference: The Kaula tradition belongs to those free from elaboration, not to the bound being.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of paśuḥ to the rest of the verse is ambiguous.
plain_english: O lord, O beloved, this Kaula tradition is for those free from elaboration; the bound being is excluded.
